exposure: enzymes of polyamine metabolism (ornithine decarboxylase (ODC), spermidine/spermine N1-acetyltransferase (SSAT), polyamine oxidase (PAO), spermine oxidase (SMO))
cohort: The study included 26 healthy pregnant women and 17 pregnant women diagnosed with placental syndrome.
finding: Women with placental syndrome showed significantly higher levels of 1-deoxySL, spermine, and spermidine, with reduced ODC and SSAT levels, and weaker correlations between biomolecules and enzymes, compared to healthy pregnant women.
